overview: SeaSpace is an aparthotel on Watergate Road at Porth, on the edge of Newquay, overlooking the Atlantic. It offers studios and two- and three-bedroom apartments with their own kitchens, plus a pool, hot tub, gym, padel courts, play areas, a café and a restaurant. Porth Beach is a short walk away and Watergate Bay is about five minutes by car.
surfTripFit: Self-catering units, on-site board hire and surf coaching packages, and quick access to Porth, Watergate and Fistral make it a flexible surf base.
